newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK five-year notes avg accepted yield 6.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK five-year notes avg accepted yield 6.77 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the five-year Exchange Fund notes tendered on Monday was 99.61 yielding 6.77 percent versus 7.23 percent at a previous tender in September.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue totalled HK$2.73 billion, up from HK$2.23 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted yield was 6.77 percent while the average tendered yield was 6.78 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.57 percent and mature on December 17, 2001.
